task.description: WF-02 Step 1: design the operator-facing history-retirement screen. Includes an ORCH-approved scope decision to design the required new backend HTTP surface as in-scope (REQ-376 shipped the retirement mechanism with no HTTP API), per REQ-399 precedent.
acceptance_criteria: the retirement screen lets a PLATFORM_ADMIN retire the oldest eligible month and displays the resulting retirement record, matching EO-001's operator-console evidence requirement
the retention summary shows a protected-record count capturable before and after a retirement, matching EO-002's evidence requirement
the screen is reachable only to a PLATFORM_ADMIN-equivalent role from the operator console navigation
web/tests/e2e/pipelines/platform-partition-retention-drop.pipeline.e2e.spec.ts is authored against this real screen and passes

result.summary: Designed Letflow.EventStore.RetentionOperations + new /event-retention router (async 202+poll pattern, fanout across tenant schemas via PartitionMaintenance.retire_month/3) and the full frontend integration (API client, hooks, page, nav/router entries, E2E spec plan) in lib/letflow/design/req377-history-retirement-screen.md.
issues: OQ1-OQ5, resolved during rework round 1 (OQ5) or left as genuinely open (OQ1-OQ4, non-blocking)
